Sub UpdateGeorgiaTaxLabels()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim r As Long
    Dim amount As Double

    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

    For r = 1 To lastRow
        If InStr(1, CStr(ws.Cells(r, "E").Value), _
                 "Georgia Its Tax", vbTextCompare) > 0 Then

            If IsNumeric(ws.Cells(r, "F").Value) Then
                amount = CDbl(ws.Cells(r, "F").Value)

                If amount = Fix(amount) Then
                    ws.Cells(r, "E").Value = "Georgia WH Tax"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(r, "E").Value = "Georgia Sales Tax"
                End If
            End If
        End If
    Next r

End Sub

Sub UpdateGeorgiaTaxLabels()

    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim i As Long
    Dim taxValue As Variant

    Set ws = ActiveSheet
    lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, "E").End(xlUp).Row

    For i = 1 To lastRow
        If Trim$(ws.Cells(i, "E").Value) = "Georgia Its Tax" Then

            taxValue = ws.Cells(i, "F").Value

            If IsNumeric(taxValue) And Len(taxValue) > 0 Then
                If CDbl(taxValue) = Int(CDbl(taxValue)) Then
                    ws.Cells(i, "E").Value = "Georgia WH Tax"
                Else
                    ws.Cells(i, "E").Value = "Georgia Sales Tax"
                End If
            End If

        End If
    Next i

End Sub
